context: Two friends compare their seminar projects
purpose: Teach: 扱っ/フォーム/有する/見出し/果たす/コレクション/予備/ゼミ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日のゼミ発表、すごく緊張したよ。
lines.en: I was so nervous about today's seminar presentation.
lines.style: Casual, slightly tired tone with a small sigh.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: え、大学のゼミってそんなに大変なの?どんなテーマを扱ったの?
lines.en: Huh, is the university seminar really that tough? What topic did you cover?
lines.style: Curious teenage voice, leaning in with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地方の小さな図書館が地域で果たす役割について調べたんだ。
lines.en: I looked into the role small local libraries play in their communities.
lines.style: Thoughtful, explaining slowly with quiet pride in the topic.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ、面白そう!私の学校の課題は古い本のコレクションを紹介するやつだったよ。
lines.en: Wow, sounds interesting! My school assignment was introducing an old book collection.
lines.style: Bright, animated teen voice with rising excitement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね。発表の見出しはどうやって決めたの?
lines.en: Nice. How did you decide on the headings for your presentation?
lines.style: Engaged, asking like a friend offering some advice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 申込フォームの欄が小さくて、短いタイトルしか入らなかったの。予備の案も全部ボツになっちゃった。
lines.en: The application form's box was tiny, so only a short title fit. My backup ideas all got shot down too.
lines.style: Slightly frustrated, exasperated teen complaining playfully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あー、わかる。うちの大学も同じような書式を有する書類ばっかりで困るよ。
lines.en: Ah, I get it. My university also has tons of papers with the same kind of format, it's a pain.
lines.style: Sympathetic, commiserating with a wry little chuckle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも、レンの発表絶対面白かったと思う。今度資料見せてね!
lines.en: But I bet your presentation was definitely interesting. Show me the materials next time!
lines.style: Cheerful, admiring tone ending with an upbeat request.
